university.name: Aston University
university.overview: A triple-accredited business school located in the heart of Birmingham with a high focus on employability.
university.admission_requirements: UCAS tariff 120-136; IELTS 6.5; Strong academic record for Pharmacy/Eng.
university.financial_aid: Aston Global Excellence Scholarship (up to £5,000); MBA grants.

courses.overview: Specialist final year at a triple-accredited business school.
courses.modules: Strategic Management, Operations, International Business

courses.title: MRes Business and Management

courses.modules: Management Research Methods, Advanced Analytics, Thesis

scholarships.name: Aston Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Open to students from all countries outside the UK; Must hold an offer for a full-time Undergraduate program; Awarded based on academic achievement (equivalent to AAB at A-Level); Submission of a 500-word personal statement on career goals.
scholarships.description: Aston’s flagship merit-based award designed to support the most academically gifted international students. The value is tiered based on the strength of the application and is applied as a reduction in the first year's tuition fees.

scholarships.name: Aston Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must hold an offer for a taught Master’s degree (excluding MBA); Hold a 2:1 or equivalent in a relevant undergraduate degree; Applicants must demonstrate leadership potential and commitment to their chosen industry through a personal statement.
scholarships.description: A prestigious award for international postgraduates aimed at attracting top global talent to Birmingham. It provides a significant reduction in tuition fees to assist high-achievers in specializing within Aston's business, engineering, and health faculties.
